answer: The zenith I would price into every new account is Vetted astronaut candidate medical record with space agency attestation: a record the agency renews after medical reviews, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a record the agency renews after medical reviews takes calendar time as well as money — and the ledge is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The inlet is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
